map.📖 查看「利润率（单品/店铺）统计 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Profit Margin (Product / Store) Statistics Guide"
map.毛利 = 营收 − 成本；净利 = 营收 − 成本 − 费用 − 税费；毛利率: Gross profit = revenue − cost; net profit = revenue − cost − expenses − taxes; gross margin = gross profit / revenue; net margin = net profit / revenue
map.输入单品或店铺的销售额、采购成本、运营费用与税费，快速测算毛利、净利与对应利润率: Enter the sales, purchase cost, operating expenses and taxes of a product or a store to quickly estimate gross profit, net profit and the corresponding margins, with an optional units-sold figure for per-product profit.
map.📚 深度解析：利润率（单品/店铺）统计: 📚 In-depth Analysis: Profit Margin (Product / Store) Statistics
map.盈利核算：录入销售额与各项费，算: Profit accounting: enter sales and each expense item to compute
map.单品对比：对多 SKU 录入，排序找高/低利润品。: Product comparison: enter several SKUs and rank them to find the high- and low-margin products.
map.教学演示：演示净利率=毛利−费用−退款后/销售额。: Classroom demo: net margin = (gross profit − expenses − refunds) / revenue.
map.示例：销售额 10 万、采购 5 万、推广 1.5 万、佣金 0.5 万、物流: Example: sales 100000, purchases 50000, promotion 15000, commission 5000, logistics 8000 gives net profit 22000 and a net margin of 22%.
map.毛利扣直接成本，净利再扣推广/佣金/物流/退款与税费，店铺级看净利更真实。结果仅: Gross profit deducts direct costs, while net profit also deducts promotion, commission, logistics, refunds and taxes; at store level net profit is the truer figure. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.退款冲减收入且常有运费损失，应计入，否则利润虚高。结果仅供电商运营测算、选品与决: Refunds reduce revenue and usually carry a shipping loss, so they must be included or profit looks inflated. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.单品为负利？: What if a product is loss-making?
map.引流款常负利(亏损拉新)，靠利润款补，整体组合盈利即可，单品看角色。结果仅供电商: Traffic-driver products are often loss-making, acquiring customers at a loss, and are offset by profit products; the mix as a whole only needs to be profitable, so judge each product by its role.
